definitions.full: H6425. peles מֶּ֫לֶס noun [masculine] balance, scale ; — literal Prov 16:11 : figurative Isa 40:11 (in both || מאֹוְנַיִם ).

occurrences.englishText: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s;
